I've been a customer for years, but the prices have become unreasonable. After applying two discounts on one receipt, I paid €10 more than usual. This will be my last experience here, and I'll switch to online shopping from other suppliers.

Courtesy and professionalism

Well stocked and really friendly staff, prices are normal, in fact there is always something on sale by registering for the customer card, plus it has a veterinary pharmacy and grooming (which I have not yet had the chance to try) all in all Highly recommended
Very well stocked pet shop and helpful staff

I went there this evening with my mom to get antibiotics for my kitten. The doctor was very kind, and the prices were really reasonable.
The lady at the cash register might be the owner, very kind people.
I came there from Marcianise.
They were the only ones open, truly a miracle.
I was satisfied.
Thanks again, doctor, even if I don't know your name 🙏😊

Here you'll find absolutely everything you need for your dog, cat, or other pet. The veterinary pharmacy is also well-stocked, and if you order anything, delivery times are incredibly short! The staff is friendly and knowledgeable.
A well-stocked pet store with friendly, courteous staff. It also offers a veterinary pharmacy, so you can buy everything you need for your furry friends in one place.

This company sells food and related products for pets and farm animals, and also has a veterinary pharmacy. Prices are quite reasonable. They have free private parking and are located opposite the Frullone metro station.

A well-stocked and spacious pet store, the staff has always been friendly and helpful. The on-site veterinary pharmacy is very convenient for finding or reserving specific pet health products. I've been going there for years and highly recommend it.
A store where you can find a little bit of everything for your furry friend. I buy accessories and trainer kibble there, which I always find on sale. I recommend...

A well-stocked store with pet food and accessories.
Polite and helpful staff.

This is a top-notch food center for four-legged friends. It stocks numerous brands of dog and cat food and kibble. There's also a wide selection of treats and toys for all sizes. The staff is helpful and courteous. The only downside, if you're really picky, is the limited parking space, but it's easily accessible from anywhere.
Wide assortment, competitive prices. I recommend it.
Always a guarantee. Kindness and a variety of products for your pet.
One of the best-stocked stores I've ever found, with super-specialized staff, a well-stocked pharmacy with a very knowledgeable doctor. Once I discovered it, I never left!

They have everything
And they're nice.

Well-stocked, friendly, and knowledgeable staff. Professional and empathetic veterinary pharmacy.
